name: Barxeta (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red above and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Barxeta (a boat, crescents and the bars of Aragon).
history: The official flag of Barxeta is of proportions 2:3, divided per bend sinister, red and white, with the crowned municipal arms at the centre; it was approved by resolution of 3 October 1994 of the Conseller of Public Administration and published in the DOGV. The arms, approved by resolution of 14 July 1992, show a boat as a canting sign alluding to the name of the town, and crescents recalling that Barxeta was an old Morisco hamlet.
